ranking_definition.name: exact iterative marginal expected-DTI gain under the pinned label-free physical corroboration field w
ranking_definition.why: R1 is a dot set, not a scored surface: it stores no per-dot evidence score. Brief 5 says to rebuild the parent's own ranking from the recorded recipe; the recorded recipe of every lineage step after GEMSDOE32 (the R1 collar prune and its exact-marginal refill, build_prune_variants.py) ranks dots by exact iterative marginal expected-DTI contribution under the canary-clean physical field w. The identical code path and identical field are used here, so the R1 arms are directly comparable to the R0 r10* family arm-for-arm.
ranking_definition.field_w: build_physical_field_and_canaries (19 pinned official bands + parent detector ridges + GDR-1391 geothermometry), every channel leakage-canaried at symmetric AUC <= 0.90
ranking_definition.instrument_note: w is a PROXY (~0.68-AUC fault model). It both ranks and scores these arms, so the in-sample w-model delta is optimistic and is reported as a diagnostic only, never as a score.

fixed_dose.source: Brief 5 MASS: 'drop the lowest-ranked 10% / add the next-ranked 10%'

hypotheses.H1_mass_optimum_is_parent_dependent: R0's measured mass curve (blind SGMC: minus -0.0080, plus +0.0029 vs R0) is confounded by 2,171 collar dots that sit next to mapped faults and are therefore unusually credit-rich. Removing that confound should move the optimum: the drop arm should lose less on R1 than it lost on R0, and the add arm should gain less, because R1's refill already consumed the 2,171 highest-marginal un-emitted candidates.
hypotheses.H2_mass_optimum_is_absolute: If the three R1 arms reproduce the R0 ordering and magnitudes (minus < R0 < plus < swap, same signs, within 0.004), then the mass curve is a property of the H19-5 detector-plus-2.8 px-thinning recipe and not of the catalogue collar, and no remaining slot should be spent on mass at any parent.

r1m10minus.operation: drop the 3,765 lowest exact-marginal-DTI dots from the 37,654-dot parent R1
r1m10minus.mechanism: A removed dot lowers S (the sum of predictions, which enters the DTI denominator) with certainty and lowers T only by the kernel credit it uniquely carries. Under DTI = T / (0.2T + 0.2(S - M) + 0.8|G|) a dot that is redundant with a stronger neighbour on the same strand is pure denominator. R0's drop arm lost, but 2,171 of R0's lowest tail were collar dots that sit ~100-300 m from mapped USGS traces, i.e. in the damage zone of real faults where true new-fault pixels are most likely. R1 cannot lose those.
r1m10minus.non_fault_mimic: The field w is built from potential-field and topographic derivatives at 400 m flight-line spacing (GeoDAWN Area 2), so a genuine but deeply buried or sediment-masked fault carries a weak expression and can rank low. If the new-fault label set is dominated by such blind faults, pruning the low-w tail deletes exactly the population being scored and the arm loses despite the algebra being right.
r1m10minus.predicted_sign_size: MODEL +0.002 vs R1; below the 0.01 no-evidence floor by construction.
r1m10minus.falsifier: A live change of -0.01 or worse vs R1 would show that the low-w tail is not dead mass even after the collar confound is removed, which forces the mass curve to be read as absolute (H2) and closes MASS for the remaining slots. A gain >= +0.01 would make mass reduction the cheapest lever in the project and would justify a 20% dose on R1 next.

r1m10plus.operation: add the 3,765 next-ranked un-emitted H19-5 dots at d_cat > 3 px (37,654 -> 41,419); no parent dot is removed
r1m10plus.mechanism: R1's construction already spent its refill budget on the 2,171 highest-marginal candidates of exactly this pool (h19_5 & ~R0 & d_cat > 3 px). The next 3,765 candidates are therefore drawn from a strictly lower part of the same marginal-gain curve, while S rises by 3,765 and the 0.8|G| term is unchanged. Addition should pay less on R1 than the +0.0029 blind that r10plus earned on R0, and may pay nothing.
r1m10plus.non_fault_mimic: Un-emitted H19-5 support includes genuine second-order structure that the 2.8 px disk suppressed: relay ramps, antithetic splays, and range-front step faults. It also includes ridge crests from flight-line levelling, drainage incision, and lithologic contacts. The arm cannot separate the two, so a positive result cannot be attributed to faults without a trace-level check.
r1m10plus.predicted_sign_size: MODEL -0.011 vs R1; the strongest of the three negative scenario anchors, and the direct test of saturation on a gate-clean parent.
r1m10plus.falsifier: A live gain >= +0.01 vs R1 falsifies saturation at this parent, proves the pool still holds unused strand length, and makes count the binding lever rather than the corroboration field.

r1m10swap.operation: count-matched substitution: drop the 3,765 lowest-ranked parent dots and add the 3,765 next-ranked un-emitted dots (d_cat > 3 px); count held at 37,654
r1m10swap.mechanism: S is frozen by construction, so this arm moves DTI through T and M alone: it is a pure ranking-quality test with the mass term removed. It superposes the denominator saving of the drop arm and the numerator gain of the add arm. R0's swap earned +0.0029 blind while carrying the collar confound; if that confound was diluting the ranking, the gate-clean version should be at least as good.
r1m10swap.non_fault_mimic: The swap inherits every bias of w: potential-field gradients favour basement-step and lithologic-contact lineaments and the GDR-1391 geothermometry term concentrates near known geothermal systems, which is a vent prior, not a fault prior. A live loss would mean the parent's geometric 2.8 px selection is a better fault detector than a 0.68-AUC physical field at equal count.
r1m10swap.predicted_sign_size: MODEL +0.006 vs R1 (best of the three on the w-model, bounded by w's ceiling).
r1m10swap.falsifier: A live change below +0.01 closes w-ranked reselection as a lever at this parent and redirects the remaining slots to geometry and support rather than to any field-driven reselection.

scenario_reading.if_swap_positive_and_minus_nonnegative: The mass curve shifted with the parent -> H1; a 20% swap on R1 becomes the next mass experiment and MASS stays live for one more slot.
scenario_reading.if_ordering_reproduces_r0: H2; record the mass curve as parent-invariant, close MASS, and spend remaining slots on the geometry/support family.
scenario_reading.no_evidence_rule: Any live |delta| < 0.01 is treated as no evidence (Brief 5). These arms cannot resolve the hypothesis alone; they bound the mass term for later multi-axis work.
